text: All 10 tests pass. I'll remove the helper test-runner script since it's not needed anymore.

Fixed three bugs in `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`**: replaced `list(set(items))` (which loses order) with a manual loop that preserves first-occurrence order using a `seen` set.
2. **`partition`**: was returning `(no, yes)` instead of `(yes, no)` — swapped the return tuple so matches come first.
3. **`windows`**: the range end was `len(items) - k`, dropping the final window — changed to `len(items) - k + 1` to include it.

All 10 tests now pass.
